annotations.title: Crypto order book, Hyperliquid: bids, asks, spread and depth of a perp

description: Live order book of a Hyperliquid perpetual (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE…): the best bid and ask levels with price, size and order count, the mid price, the spread in USD and basis points, and the summed depth on each side. Up to 20 levels a side (default 10). Read from Hyperliquid's public API. Use to judge liquidity and slippage before a trade, or for market-making and arbitrage checks. Example: coin=BTC. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
